diagnosis: The direct deposit modification endpoint executes a raw Sequelize UPDATE query that bypasses model hooks and updates banking details solely by employee_id. The endpoint never checks if req.user.employeeId matches empId or whether the caller has HR administrator privileges, allowing any employee to redirect other employees' salaries to attacker-controlled bank accounts.
